items.summary: The fair value estimate for Edgewise Therapeutics has shifted from US$54.00 to about US$56.17 per share, putting fresh attention on how analysts are updating their models. Much of this reflects new Street work on EDG-7500 in hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, along with clearer plans for Phase 3 trials and recent regulatory feedback that shape views on valuation, capital allocation, and execution risk. items.title: Raymond James bullish on Schwab amid ‘compelling valuation’
items.summary: Investing.com -- Raymond James upgraded Charles Schwab (NYSE:SCHW) to Strong Buy with a $135 price target in a note on Wednesday, telling investors that the brokerage is a clear winner from interest rates staying higher for longer.
